name: Ves
summary: Caravan scout for the Red Mule Caravan, 24, home after six years away; stubborn, observant, quiet.

name: Corin
summary: Bellwarden of Kettlehold and keeper of the Ashbell; 40s, proud, dutiful, Ves's old mentor.

name: Ysolde
summary: Captain of the Red Mule Caravan; charming, in debt, smuggles ember salt. Was Corin's sworn partner.

name: Hesper
summary: Ninety-year-old head of the Order of the Quiet Flame; dry wit, never leaves Stillfire Abbey.

name: Rourke
summary: Commander of the Pass Guard; tired, honest, drinks more than he should.

name: Aldous
summary: Corin's father, Bellwarden before him; died ringing the Ashbell on the Night of Ash.

name: Mother Brisk
summary: Runs the Kettle & Coal; feeds every caravan; knows every rumour.

fields.schedule: 06:00 kitchen · 07:30 Saltgate for salt · 12:00 lunch rush · 18:00 behind the bar · 23:00 locks up

name: Odo
summary: The town lamplighter; limps, keeps tallies, owes Ysolde money.

fields.schedule: dusk: lights Kiln Street · midnight: snuffs Kiln Street · dawn: trims wicks

name: Tamsin
summary: Sixteen-year-old courier between town and Abbey; fast, talkative, idolises Ves.

fields.schedule: 08:00 Abbey gate · 09:00 Cinder Bridge drop · afternoons on Kiln Street

name: Kettlehold
summary: Mountain town on steam vents, the last town before the summit of the pass.

name: Bell Gate
summary: Fortified gate tower at the top of town; the Ashbell hangs in it. The Pass Guard barracks are beside it.

name: Kiln Street
summary: The long main street running down from the Bell Gate to Saltgate, lined with lamps.

name: Saltgate
summary: The market square at the lower end of town by the old wall.

name: Kettle & Coal
summary: Mother Brisk's inn, on the edge of Saltgate; its back door opens onto the market stalls.

name: Cinder Bridge
summary: Iron bridge over the steam gorge, from mid–Kiln Street to the Abbey stair. Closed at dusk by the bell.

name: Stillfire Abbey
summary: Seat of the Order of the Quiet Flame, above the gorge.

name: Ember Well
summary: A hot spring in the Abbey's lower cloister. Its water grants Ashsight.

name: Old Mine
summary: Ember-salt mine below the gorge, sealed since the Night of Ash.

name: Foot of the Pass
summary: Caravan camp half a day's ride below Kettlehold.

name: Order of the Quiet Flame
summary: Monastic order that tends the Ember Well and seals dangerous places.

name: Pass Guard
summary: Town watch at the Bell Gate; enforces the bridge curfew.

name: Red Mule Caravan
summary: Ysolde's trading caravan: salt and lamp oil up, ember salt down (quietly).

name: Ashbell
summary: The great bronze bell in the Bell Gate tower. Rung every dusk to warn of ashfall and close the Cinder Bridge; ringing it costs the ringer their voice.

name: Bronze Clapper
summary: The Ashbell's clapper, stolen on Day 2.

name: Cinder Key
summary: A warm iron key that opens doors sealed by the Order.

name: Ashsight
summary: Lets the bearer see heat left by footsteps for about a day. Granted by the Ember Well.

name: The Silent Bell
summary: Main quest of Act 2: find out why the bell is silent.

name: A Debt in Salt
summary: Side quest: Odo's debt to Ysolde.

name: The Well Before Dawn
summary: Side quest: earn the right to drink from the Ember Well.

name: Night of Ash
summary: The eruption ten years before the story (D-3650).
